quote: And so I betake myself to that course, which is almost as much as to see myself go into my grave: for which, and all the discomforts that will accompany my being blind, the good God prepare me!
source: Samuel Pepys, The Diary of Samuel Pepys, 31 May 1669, the closing words (ed. Henry B. Wheatley, George Bell, 1893)
